name: CSERP-010: No JWT revocation — add Redis blacklist + jti claim

acceptance_criteria: AC-1: signAccessToken adds a jti (UUID) claim to every JWT
AC-2: verifyAccessToken extracts and validates the jti claim
AC-3: Logout route blacklists the access token jti in Redis with 15-min TTL
AC-4: getApiUser checks Redis blacklist before accepting a token
AC-5: Blacklist entries auto-expire after 15 minutes (matching access token lifetime)
AC-6: If Redis is unavailable, token validation falls through (fail-open for availability)
content.fix: Add jti to JWT, create blacklistToken/isTokenBlacklisted functions, wire into logout + getApiUser
